text: Amanita participated in the 2023 edition of Palai, exhibiting works by Francesco Cima, Leonardo Meoni and Daniele Milvio.
Palai opened July 28th at Palazzo Tamborini Cezzi in Lecce, Italy. The exhibition comprised over seventy works from a selection of international galleries and artists.

Participating galleries: 15 orient (New York), Amanita (New York), Barbara Weiss (Berlin), Balice Hertling (Paris), Bel Ami (Los Angeles), Delgosha (Tehran), Ermes Ermes (Rome), HUA International (Beijing / Berlin), Isla Flotante (Buenos Aires), LC Queisser (Tblisi), Tara Downs (New York)

Participating artists: Alfredo Aceto, Yalda Afsah, Ali Ansari, Tolia Astakhishvili, Haydeh Ayazi, Cay Bahnmiller, Camille Blatrix, Ljiljana Blazevska, Vivian Caccuri, Jiang Cheng, Xinyi Cheng, Milano Chow, Francesco Cima, Enzo Cucchi, Chen Dandizi, Rafael Domench, Kim Farkas, Owen Fu, Thea Gvetadze, Nino Kapanadze, Behrang Karimi, Jannis Marwitz, Mina Masoumi, Leonardo Meoni, Daniele Milvio, Julien Monnerie, Kayode Ojo, Ana Prata, Puppies Puppies (Jade Guanaro Kuriki-Olivo), Mostafa Sarabi, Ser Serpas, Shabahang Tayyari, Zhi Wei, Tsai Yun-Ju, Jenkin Van Zyl
